rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the background or setting that helps explain an event.

example.english: The context of this film is the World War II era.
example.traditional: 呢套戲嘅背景係二戰時期。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 bui3 ging2 hai6 ji6 zin3 si4 kei4

rows.note: Use this when context means the particular circumstances or situation rather than general background.

example.english: In the current context, we cannot afford to delay any longer.
example.traditional: 而家呢個情況唔容許我哋再拖。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 ni1 go3 cing4 fong3 m4 jung4 heoi2 ngo5 dei6 zoi3 to1

rows.note: Use this for the linguistic context that determines the meaning of a word or passage.

example.english: The context of this word in this sentence is very important.
example.traditional: 呢個字喺呢句入面嘅語境好重要。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zi6 hai2 ni1 geoi3 jap6 min6 ge3 jyu5 ging2 hou2 zung6 jiu3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the surrounding written text in which a word or passage appears.

example.english: When reading an English word, you need to understand it together with the context.
example.traditional: 睇英文生字，要連埋上下文一齊理解。
example.jyutping: tai2 jing1 man4 sang1 zi6 jiu3 lin4 maai4 soeng6 haa6 man4 jat1 cai4 lei5 gaai2
